title: Explicit per-solve step-duration and numerical-control binding into HeadCalc

problem.architectural_issue: the explicit common request is validated against legacy globals, but HeadCalc still consumes those globals instead of the already-explicit per-solve request controls

required_behavior.explicit_common_route: HeadCalc consumes request step_duration and numerical config supplied by the adapter/service call
required_behavior.legacy_route: when explicit controls are absent, preserve current legacy-global behavior exactly

qualification_strategy.reference_profile: carry forward F-SI11 admitted swkimpl=0, swmacro=0, explicit top, F-SI09 constitutive, F-SI10 drainage/irrigation, F-SI11 precomputed root sink
qualification_strategy.authoritative_request_test: construct a valid request, then poison only the legacy numerical-control globals that F-SI12 removes from the explicit HeadCalc path; the common solve must remain bit-identical while the legacy direct route remains unchanged when explicit controls are omitted
qualification_strategy.mass_rule: no rounded proxy; focused unrounded residual and existing hard accounting gates remain mandatory
